title: Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy Billing Rules for Installments, Late Fees and Renewal Billing
content:
## Rule 1: billing plans

On the annual plan the whole term premium of a Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy is due on the effective date. On the monthly EFT plan it is billed in twelve installments due monthly from the effective date: each later installment is the term premium divided by twelve, rounded half-up to the cent, and installment 1 takes the difference, that is the term premium less the eleven later installments. The tier's installment service charge is charged on each installment after the first.

## Rule 2: status in which installments are billed

Installments are billed only while the umbrella is bound, in force or pending cancellation.

| Umbrella status | Installments billed? |
|---|---|
| Bound | Yes |
| In force | Yes |
| Pending cancellation | Yes |
| Cancelled | No |
| Expired | No |

The status is the one the company's umbrella record shows for that umbrella.

## Rule 3: late fee

A late fee is charged once per installment still unpaid more than the tier's late fee grace days (calendar days) after its due date, and never when the tier's late fee is 0.00.

## Rule 4: renewal billing

Renewal installment 1 is billed the tier's renewal billing lead time (calendar days) before expiration, at the term premium recomputed on the exposures in force on that day.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical inputs)

**Monthly installments.** Hypothetical term premium $454.00 on the monthly EFT plan. $454.00 divided by twelve is 37.8333, rounded half-up to $37.83; that is installments 2 through 12. The eleven later installments total $416.13, so installment 1 is $454.00 less $416.13, which is $37.87. On a tier whose installment service charge is $2.00, the charge is added to installments 2 through 12 and not to installment 1.

**Due dates.** Hypothetical effective date 15 April: installment 1 is due 15 April, installment 2 on 15 May, and so on monthly, installment 12 on 15 March.

**Late fee boundary.** Hypothetical installment due 1 March on a tier with 10 grace days and a late fee above 0.00. Still unpaid on 11 March, which is 10 days after the due date: no late fee, since 10 is not more than 10. Still unpaid on 12 March, 11 days after: the late fee is charged, once for that installment. On a tier whose late fee is 0.00, no late fee is charged however late the installment.

**Renewal billing date.** Hypothetical expiration date 1 October with a lead time of 45 days: renewal installment 1 is billed on 17 August, at the term premium recomputed on the vehicles, youthful drivers, rental units and watercraft in force on 17 August.

## Basis questions

**Is a late fee charged twice on the same installment?** No; the fee is charged once per installment.

**Can a cancelled umbrella be billed an installment?** No; installments are billed only in the bound, in force and pending cancellation statuses.
